data.review_body:
I am extremely disappointed with the way Temu has handled my late-delivery compensation.
I had 12 orders that arrived late, and each one showed that £4 late-delivery compensation would be credited within 48 hours. However, I have only received compensation for 5 of the 12 orders, leaving 7 outstanding.
I have provided screenshots showing the evidence for all 12 late deliveries, but despite this, I have now been given several different explanations as to why the remaining compensation cannot be paid. None of these explanations properly addresses the evidence I have provided.
During an earlier conversation with customer service, I was also promised an additional £5 credit for the inconvenience this situation had caused. This has still not been paid.
Another customer service representative subsequently processed 5 payments of £4, but told me they could not process the remaining payments or the promised £5 and therefore raised a ticket. Since then, Ali from the Customer Solutions Team has responded, but the response does not appear to acknowledge or address the screenshots I supplied showing that the remaining orders were also eligible for late-delivery compensation.
Normally, Temu's £4 late-delivery credit is issued automatically. On the last three occasions this has not happened. On the previous two occasions I eventually received the compensation after contacting customer service, but this time I am having considerable difficulty getting the matter resolved.
I am a very regular Temu customer and spend thousands of pounds through the company, purchasing for a large family as well as other people. I follow Temu's terms and conditions and therefore expect Temu to honour its own promises and policies in return.
If Temu's policy states that eligible late deliveries receive £4 compensation, that policy should be applied consistently regardless of whether a customer has one late delivery or several. The fact that I have 12 affected orders should not prevent me from receiving compensation on each order if each one individually qualifies.
I am also disappointed that my emails and photographic evidence do not appear to be properly addressed. This has left me feeling that because the total amount of compensation is higher this time, Temu is reluctant to honour it.
There have been other changes to my account that have also reduced my confidence in continuing to shop with Temu, including the removal of my discount card and promotions where I now have to spend a very substantial amount before receiving the advertised coupon benefits.
I am therefore asking Temu to review the evidence I have already supplied and resolve this properly by paying the outstanding compensation for the remaining 7 eligible late orders, together with the additional £5 credit that customer service promised me.
If this cannot be resolved fairly, my family, friends and I will seriously consider purchasing elsewhere in future. After spending such significant amounts with Temu, I do not believe I should have to repeatedly chase the company simply to receive compensation that its own system stated I was entitled to.
Please provide a clear response addressing each of the outstanding 7 orders and the promised £5 credit, rather than another general explanation.

I, won't be ordering again at least until this has been sorted 

Thank you.

Update :

You say you have escalated it but you don't know my details before I've given them so that's not true it seems you want people to see you are dealing with the issue. 
I have attached my details and you still haven't made contact with me. 
So again I contacted you though chat and have another ticket raised and still nothing as of yet. 
Why say £4 for late deliveries if your not willing to pay them even with screenshots and the screenshot of £5 goodwill gesture your refusing to pay. 
Shame on you and your company!!!!! No wonder your rating are sooooo poor!!!!! 
Once I receive the rest of my air delivery and land delivery orders I'm deleting my account and spend my money elsewhere. 
If anyone's hasn't deleted their account, delete it you will end up being deceived!!!!! good luck if you don't!!!!!

data.review_body:
I was adding items to my cart just to compare and decide what to buy — I was especially interested in a solar panel and battery kit. Without my confirmation, the app went ahead and charged my account for everything in the cart, including items I had left unmarked/unselected.

I canceled the order within about 8 minutes, and the app confirmed a refund would be issued around July 27th. Two days later, I got a message saying they had refunded $160 — but my bank showed a charge of $584, because they had also processed the items I never selected for purchase.

When I filed a complaint, I was told these were "different sellers" and that the items had already shipped, so the charge couldn't be canceled.

I've also compared notes with friends who've had similar experiences: the price shown when browsing is often not the price actually charged — it increases by around 20%, and in some cases shipping is added on top, without clear disclosure. This feels like a deliberate practice, not a glitch.

If Temu is a Chinese company, this kind of behavior reflects poorly on a government that claims to take a strong stance against theft and fraud.

I would urge others to be extremely careful with this app — take screenshots of your cart before checking out, and monitor your bank account closely after any order.
data.review_headline: Beware: Temu charged me for items I never selected
